text: DSH-better-sidebar（DSH 网页插件）：把文件树、编辑器、变更、任务和侧聊整合到按会话隔离的侧栏工作区。用户可以浏览、编辑项目文件，查看 Git 差异，跟踪任务与子代理进度，并在工作区旁继续对话。适合希望在 DSH 中集中处理代码和会话的开发者，无需额外密钥。

DSH-better-sidebar is a DSH web plugin that combines a file tree, editor, Git changes, tasks, and side chat in a conversation-scoped workspace. Developers can browse and edit project files, inspect diffs, follow tasks and subagent progress, and chat alongside their work. It is suited to people managing code and conversations in DSH, with no additional API key required.

dsh-better-sidebar README · 🌿 Git Graph (read-only commit graph)：Switch to **Git Graph** at the top of the Git panel for commit nodes, forks and merge edges across local branches, remote-tracking branches and HEAD. The branch selector only filters history — it **never checks out or fetches**; each commit is one line (lane edges + ref pills + subject), hover shows the author and short hash, and selecting one opens its full message and diff in the bottom pane. History loads in pages; reference changes during pagination prompt a refresh; reads are bounded (200 commits per page, offset 10,000, 1,000 branches) and report an explicit error past a limit. Lightweight and annotated tags appear on commits in the graph, rows and details use neutral tag pills, and tag changes invalidate pagination. Tag decorations keep the first 5,000 tags by ref name, further bounded by an 8 MiB complete-line output prefix; excess tags are omitted without failing the graph.

dsh-better-sidebar README · 🧭 dsh-context diagnostics (optional)：With the `dsh-context` plugin installed, three places offer a one-click jump into that conversation's **Context** view: an agent node's detail card on the Tasks page, a background job's output window (the job's real owner session — never merely the session its row was watched under), and the session header. The entries **appear only** while dsh-context's `Context` page is actually registered: a deployment without it (or with that page hidden) shows no control at all, and while one jump is in flight every entry point is disabled. A failed jump is reported once, in a dismissible alert at the frame's bottom edge; nothing is polled while idle.

dsh-better-sidebar README · 🚀 Installation：> **Compatibility warning — match the plugin to the host line.** As of 2026-11-04, DSH's npm `latest` is **0.2.1-rc.5** and `next` is **0.2.2-rc.1**. **v0.30.0 requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+**; hosts on the 0.2.1 line (**0.2.1-rc.1 ~ rc.5**, i.e. today's `latest`) must pin `dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.2` — v0.29.0 was never published to npm. DSH 0.2.1-alpha.5 users must pin `dsh-better-sidebar@0.28.0-alpha.0`, and hosts still on **0.2.0-rc.2** must pin `dsh-better-sidebar@0.26.1`. A 0.x caret never spans a minor version, so one plugin build cannot serve two host lines. The marketplace installer picks the plugin's `latest` regardless of host version, so an old host gets a version-rejection error — upgrade the host or pin the version explicitly. The two packages' `latest` tags are independent.

| `Ignored build scripts` error | pnpm 11 blocked a transitive dependency's build script. Run `pnpm approve-builds` in the profile directory (`~/.dsh/profiles/web`) — this plugin itself has no build-script dependencies. |
| `minimum release age` / version younger than 24h | The release is less than 24 hours old. Wait 24h or re-run (pnpm auto-adds `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`). |
| "Profile directory not found" | Run `dsh web` once to initialize `~/.dsh/profiles/web`. |
| Host dies on start: `DesktopHostFatalError: … required plugins did not activate / better-sidebar` | The profile carries its own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` copies (left by an older DSH, or listed in the profile's `package.json` / overrides) and they resolve ahead of the installation, so the `dsh-subagent` this plugin imports statically binds to a mixed set; when an export is missing the host only reports this fatal and never names the package. Confirm with the check shipped in the current plugin: `node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-better-sidebar/scripts/check-profile-host-tree.mjs ~/.dsh/profiles/web`. 🔐 Security & ⚠️ Known Limitations

dsh-better-sidebar README · 🧰 Enhancements & tools：- Routes sit behind a Host-header trust fence (same as `/api`); `fs.write` is atomic; git is only invoked via CLI and never sets identity
- ⚠️ **Since v0.23.0 the fs routes do no workspace-containment check**: they can read/write any path the host user can reach (OS permissions only) — callers must not treat these routes as fenced
- HTML previews render in an **opaque-origin sandboxed iframe** and serve relative CSS, JavaScript, JSON, fonts and WebAssembly with their content types; the sandbox can be disabled per feature in settings (off by default, with warnings)
- No git push/pull/fetch; the file tree only watches **expanded** directories; Markdown preview renders the saved file
- Read-only formats (spreadsheets / PDF / images / Office) are rendered by DSH's own document preview and follow the host version; the browser view only exists in the desktop profile
- Unsaved drafts are confirmed before closing a tab / deleting a file / refreshing; saving after external modification is rejected, never silently overwritten
- On mobile (<768px) there is no bottom panel — its tabs merge into the right sidebar's full-width drawer
